# Select

> A button that opens a list of Options to pick one or more from. It submits just like a `<select>`.

`<slab-select>` · Selection · built on `[role=combobox] + [role=listbox]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/select/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/select.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-select label="Country" name="country" placeholder="Choose one">
  <slab-option value="ca">Canada</slab-option>
  <slab-option value="mx">Mexico</slab-option>
  <slab-option value="us">United States</slab-option>
</slab-select>
```

Its Options, and Option Groups, are the same ones [Listbox](listbox.md) uses.

`show()`, `hide()` and `toggle()` open and close it from code, as `open` does. `showPicker()` opens it too, but like a native select's, it only works from a user gesture, such as a click, and throws while it's disabled.

## Keyboard

| Key                               | What it does                                                                                     |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Enter, Space, Up, Down, Home, End | Closed, opens it.                                                                                |
| Alt+Down                          | Closed, opens it without moving the active Option.                                               |
| A character                       | Closed, selects the next Option whose label starts with what's typed, without opening it.        |
| Enter, Space                      | Open, selects the active Option and closes, or toggles it and stays open when `multiple` is set. |
| Tab, Alt+Up                       | Open, selects the active Option and closes. Alt+Up keeps focus where it is.                      |
| Escape                            | Open, closes without selecting.                                                                  |

Once it's open, the rest of the keys are [Listbox](listbox.md)'s.

## Elements

### `<slab-select>`

Import `slab-elements/select.js` to register it.

A select with no visual styles: a button that opens a list of Options, to select one or more from.

It isn't a native `<select>`. A customizable one, with `appearance: base-select`, can hold rich options, but Firefox doesn't support it yet. And in any browser a `<select>` only counts the `<option>` elements in its own tree, so neither an Option nor anything slotted into it from the light DOM would ever be one of its options. So this is the APG's select-only combobox: an element with `role="combobox"` that opens a `role="listbox"` element in a popover. It submits, resets, restores and validates the way a `<select>` does.

Focus stays on the combobox the whole time. Its `aria-activedescendant` points at the active Option, so the user hears each Option as they move through them.

Closed, Enter, Space, the arrow keys, Home and End open it, and Alt with the Down arrow opens it without moving. Typing selects the next Option whose label starts with what was typed, without opening it, as a native `<select>` does. Open, the keys are a Listbox's, range selection with `multiple` included. Enter, Space and a click select an Option and close it, unless `multiple` is set, where they toggle the Option and leave it open. Tab selects the active Option and closes it, and Escape closes it without selecting anything. Alt with the Up arrow does what Tab does, without moving focus.

The popover is anchored to the combobox with CSS anchor positioning, the way Popover's is. `placement` picks the side and nothing else.

Style it through its parts and through `:state(disabled)`, `:state(error)`, `:state(open)`, `:state(placeholder-shown)`, and `:state(required)`, and each Option through the states Option sets.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type                                     | Default    | Description                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`                                 |            | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                                                   |
| `disabled`         | `boolean`                                | `false`    | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                                   |
| `hide-label`       | `boolean`                                | `false`    | Hides the label visually and leaves it as the accessible name, for a design that shows the label some other way.                                                |
| `multiple`         | `boolean`                                | `false`    | Lets more than one be selected at a time.                                                                                                                       |
| `name`             | `string`                                 | `''`       | The name its value is submitted under, as a native control's `name`.                                                                                            |
| `open`             | `boolean`                                | `false`    | Whether it's open. Set it to open or close it.                                                                                                                  |
| `placeholder`      | `string`                                 |            | Shown in place of a value when no Option is selected.                                                                                                           |
| `placement`        | `'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | The side of the combobox it opens on, when there's room. It flips when there isn't.                                                                             |
| `required`         | `boolean`                                | `false`    | Makes it invalid while it has no value, as `required` does a native control.                                                                                    |
| `value`            | `string`                                 | `''`       | The value of the first selected and enabled Option. Setting it selects the Option with that value, and only that one. Not reflected, to match a native control. |

#### Properties

| Name                            | Type                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defaultValue`                  | `string`                  | The value it selects when none of its Options has `selected`, and goes back to when its form resets. It's the `value` attribute, so setting it sets the attribute, and `value` with it. |
| `form` (read-only)              | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The form it belongs to, or `null`.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `options` (read-only)           | `Option[]`                | Its Options, in order.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `selectedOptions` (read-only)   | `Option[]`                | Selected and enabled Options, in the order they appear.                                                                                                                                 |
| `validationMessage` (read-only) | `string`                  | What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`, or else the browser's own. Empty while it's valid.                        |
| `validity` (read-only)          | `ValidityState`           | Its `ValidityState`, as a native control's.                                                                                                                                             |
| `willValidate` (read-only)      | `boolean`                 | Whether its validity is checked when its form submits. It isn't while it's disabled or read-only.                                                                                       |
| `values`                        | `string[]`                | The value of every selected and enabled Option, in the order they appear. Setting it selects the Options with those values, and only those.                                             |

#### Methods

| Signature                                                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkValidity(): boolean`                                        | Whether its value is valid. Dispatches "invalid" when it isn't, as a native control's does.                                                                                        |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`                             | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                                                                                    |
| `hide(): void`                                                    | Closes it.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `reportValidity(): boolean`                                       | Whether its value is valid. When it isn't, dispatches "invalid" and shows the validity message, as a native control's does.                                                        |
| `resetValidityFeedback(): void`                                   | Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.                                                                                                                          |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string): void`                        | Makes it invalid with a message of your own, or valid again with an empty one, as a native control's does.                                                                         |
| `setValidity(flags?: ValidityStateFlags, message?: string): void` | Sets its validity and message, as `ElementInternals.setValidity()` does, for checks of your own beyond `setCustomValidity()`.                                                      |
| `show(): void`                                                    | Opens it.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `showPicker(): void`                                              | Opens it, as `show()` does. As a native select's, it throws without a user gesture, or while it's disabled.                                                                        |
| `toggle(force?: boolean): boolean`                                | Opens it when it's closed, and closes it when it's open, as a native popover's `togglePopover()` does. `true` only opens it and `false` only closes it. Returns whether it's open. |

#### Events

| Name           | Type          | Description                                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toggle`       | `ToggleEvent` | When it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` with `oldState` and `newState` that doesn't bubble, as a popover's does. |
| `input`        | `Event`       | As the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.                 |
| `change`       | `Event`       | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.               |
| `invalid`      | `Event`       | When a check finds its value invalid, as a native control's does. Cancel it to leave the validity message unshown.   |
| `beforetoggle` | `ToggleEvent` | Before it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` that doesn't bubble. Cancel it while it's opening to keep it closed.   |

#### Slots

| Name          | Type                    | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default)     | `Option \| OptionGroup` |                                                                                                             |
| `description` | `Element \| string`     | Text that describes it, such as a hint or what the validity message means. It's its accessible description. |

#### CSS parts

| Name               | Description                                                          |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `combobox`         | What opens the Options and shows what's selected                     |
| `description`      | Text about the Select, and its validity message when it has one      |
| `label`            | The label                                                            |
| `listbox`          | The Options                                                          |
| `popover`          | What the Options open in                                             |
| `validity-message` | The validity message, which says why the value is invalid            |
| `value`            | The selected Options' labels, or the placeholder when there are none |

#### CSS states

| Name                        | Description                                                                                                               |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)`          | While it's disabled.                                                                                                      |
| `:state(error)`             | While it's invalid and its validity message shows, which is once its validity is reported, as when its form is submitted. |
| `:state(open)`              | While it's open.                                                                                                          |
| `:state(placeholder-shown)` | While nothing is selected and its placeholder shows, as `:placeholder-shown` matches a native input's.                    |
| `:state(required)`          | While it's required, for styles such as an asterisk.                                                                      |
